title: ACEF v1.1 Evidence Gap Payload (overlay)
description: ACEF Core v1.1 overlay of evidence_gap. Inlines the v1.0 property set (kept backward-compatible) and adds conditional discriminator-keyed oneOf enforcement for the evidence_freshness_window and regression_definition variants (per VAL-VARIANT-004 and the v1.1 variant-registry entries for /payload/gap_class). Records that do NOT set /payload/gap_class validate exactly as under v1.0.

missing_record_type.description: The record type that is missing or incomplete.

reason_description.description: Detailed human-readable explanation of why the evidence is missing.

expected_completion_date.description: Expected date when the evidence will be available (ISO 8601). Null if unknown.

remediation_plan.description: Description of the plan to remediate the evidence gap.

remediation_owner.description: Person or team responsible for the remediation.

gap_severity.description: How critical this evidence gap is to overall compliance.

blocking_provisions.description: Regulatory provisions that are blocked or affected by this evidence gap.

alternative_evidence.description: Description of any alternative or partial evidence available.

alternative_evidence_ref.description: URN reference to alternative evidence record, if available.

hash_commitment.description: SHA-256 hash commitment of the confidential evidence.

nda_reference.description: Reference to the NDA covering this evidence.

third_party_name.description: Name of the third party blocking evidence collection.

third_party_contact_date.description: Date the third party was contacted about providing the evidence (ISO 8601).

not_applicable_justification.description: Justification for why the evidence is not applicable.

gap_class.description: v1.1 discriminator for evidence_gap variants. Values registered in v1.1 variant-registry.json: 'evidence_freshness_window' (time-bounded freshness gap) and 'regression_definition' (regression-test-pending gap).

window_start.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking the start of the freshness window (evidence_freshness_window variant).

window_end.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking the end of the freshness window (evidence_freshness_window variant).

refresh_due_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp by which evidence MUST be refreshed (evidence_freshness_window variant).

current_freshness_state.description: Current freshness state for the evidence in this window (evidence_freshness_window variant).

regression_id.description: URN-shaped identifier for the regression definition (regression_definition variant).

surface_class.description: Surface or capability class that the regression applies to (regression_definition variant).

baseline_evidence_ref.description: URN of the baseline evidence record this regression definition is anchored against (regression_definition variant).

allOf.$comment: VAL-VARIANT-004 conditional oneOf for evidence_freshness_window. When /payload/gap_class is 'evidence_freshness_window', the four window-specific fields are required.
VAL-VARIANT-004 conditional oneOf for regression_definition. When /payload/gap_class is 'regression_definition', the three regression-specific fields are required.
